resources.name: Open-source DFT software with plane-wave PAW, GGA+U, and NEB support (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: The paper used VASP; any open-source DFT code capable of spin-polarized GGA+U and climbing-image NEB (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K) is acceptable.
Used to build and manipulate the spinel supercell and set up NEB calculations.
